name: OAK RGB, fixed forward mount
pitch_source: Mount design value stated by the operator on 2026-11-22; not measured on the airframe
notes: The camera is fixed to the airframe and looks along the nose, pitched below the horizon. There is no gimbal: the aircraft's yaw points the camera.
Plans are tested at the pitch and at both ends of the tolerance. Replace both values when the pitch has been measured.
